Current implementation awaiting acceptance:
The unwired transport uses proposed Snow0.10 Noise KK/Curve25519/ChaChaPoly/SHA256, independent private node keys and a fixed approved three-voter roster. Handshakes bind the roster, community, partition and node pair. No plaintext fallback or early application data. Discovered endpoints must match exactly; authenticated sender and membership checks precede Raft. Enrollment, revocation and rotation remain absent.
Before wiring, minimal Snow features must include use-getrandom; x25519-dalek2.0.1 and zeroize1.9.0 are already locked. Preserve every security dependency patch.
The TCP/process test stays under tests/pending/encrypted_tcp_contract.rs. Written coverage includes private-key safeguards, authenticated actual-handler refusals/positive vote, stalled connection budgets, deadlines and shutdown. Outbound connections share a default4/max16 semaphore across factories, refuse overload before serialization/dial, and release after cancellation or timeout without a waiter queue.
Private worker configuration is bounded and checks held inode, permissions, link count and owner. Replies identify the node and distinguish durable application from observed term/leader/snapshot/purge. Exact durable receipt hashes and original receipt readback establish convergence.
The separate process scenario has a private Unix control socket, 100-second OS watchdog and bounded command count/lifetime. Known direct children are killed/reaped and reopened for each voter, all-node restart, original retry and minority isolation/heal. A missing follower spans thirty majority writes; real purge, snapshot catchup and a second kill/reopen must preserve all thirty-five exact receipts.
A separate staged test launches the real child with five unsafe-key variants: absent, truncated, mismatched, public or hard-linked. Each must exit/reap before store, lock or control socket creation.
